mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.name: get-customer-by-churn-level
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: return the customer details accourding to Churn Risk Level

salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, AccountNumber, Email__c, Joined_on__c, tenure_year__c, Last_Billing_Date__c, Valid_Till__c, Total_Revenue__c, Autopay_Enabled__c, Contact_Preferances__c, Churn_Score__c, Churn_Risk_Level__c FROM Account WHERE Churn_Risk_Level__c = :riskLevel AND AccountNumber LIKE 'ACC%' ORDER BY Churn_Score__c DESC

logger.doc:name: Log - Query Result
logger.message: #["[get-customer-by-churn-level-flow] Salesforce query returned " ++ (sizeOf(payload) as String) ++ " records"]
